details.title: Fixed BDF can solve the wrong time-grid equation under a change of time units
details.novelty: The absolute same_step floor is explicitly disclosed in R3 closure. The resulting2.08% wrong constant-flow endpoint and the unit-covariance counterexample are newly executed here; not classified as an undisclosed regression.
details.mechanism: same_step compares the difference with32eps*max(|h|,|previous_h|,1). Distinct tiny represented intervals therefore select equal-step3,-4,1 coefficients. For exact linear flow their residual is v*(h-previous_h), not0. Exact rational replay identifies that wrong residual as the source of the native answer.
details.scope: Public fixed BDF reference implementation, scalar identity-mass constant flow on the preregistered unit grid. No new full-BDF or production-comparator promotion.

findings.title: Unequal represented half steps retain an equal-half Richardson divisor
findings.scope: Executed on native public Radau1 kernels and adaptive observed driver. Dense driver shares the trial by source inspection, not a second native execution. Nonconstant BDF startup is only a followup risk because it also changes order/history; no unchecked transfer of the Radau1 correction.

details.title: Unequal represented half steps retain an equal-half Richardson divisor
details.novelty: Newly reproduced mismatch between unequal represented halves and the existing equal-half estimator; prior-version correctness on the identical fixture was not executed, so an introduced regression is not established.
details.mechanism: The divisor2^p-1 assumes equal halves. With eta=(h1/H)^(p+1)+(h2/H)^(p+1), the leading fine-error magnitude is eta/(1-eta)*|fine-coarse|. Here p=1, eta=5/9 and the correct factor is5/4; the relation is exact for the quadratic primitive.
details.scope: Executed on native public Radau1 kernels and adaptive observed driver. Dense driver shares the trial by source inspection, not a second native execution. Nonconstant BDF startup is only a followup risk because it also changes order/history; no unchecked transfer of the Radau1 correction.
details.interpretation_limit: This shows violation of the estimator's geometry assumptions; it does not assume adaptive tolerances are rigorous global error bounds for arbitrary ODEs.
